questions.question_text: Disclose any litigation or claims against your organization in the last five years that relate to services of this kind.
Provide three client references for comparable projects using the table in Appendix B.
questions.constraints: three references, table in Appendix B

questions.question_text: Any actual or potential conflict of interest relating to this RFP must be disclosed.
Provide a profile of your organization, including years in business, number of employees and head office location.
Does your organization have an office in Alberta? (Yes/No)
Please describe how the digital content lending platform scales to support peak loads and growth in the number of users.
Does the digital content lending platform keep an audit log of user activity that administrators cannot alter? (Yes/No)
Describe the licensing model (named user, concurrent or enterprise) and how licence counts are measured.
Proponent to describe how holds queues are managed across member libraries.
(Desirable) Describe how the platform integrates with the library card database of the Consortium.
Confirm that titles from Canadian publishers can be loaded and shown as a collection. (Yes/No)
Please describe the reading applications provided, including offline reading and accessibility features.
Attach a sample monthly usage report.
Describe the channels through which users can request support.
State the target response and resolution times for each severity level.
Confirm that support is available on statutory holidays. (Yes/No)
How is patron data encrypted at rest and in transit, and who holds the encryption keys?
Please describe how you comply with the Freedom of Information and Protection of Privacy Act (Alberta) and any other privacy legislation that applies to patron data.
Describe your disaster recovery plan, including recovery time and recovery point objectives.
Will any patron data be stored, processed or accessed outside Canada? (Yes/No)
Does your organization hold a current ISO/IEC 27001 certification? (Yes/No)
Describe how administrative access to production systems is controlled and logged.
Describe how security events are monitored and who responds outside business hours.
State whether penetration testing is performed by an independent party. (Yes/No)
Please describe how you will support organizational change management and user adoption.
Describe the warranty provided and what it excludes.
What training materials are included, and are they available in French?
What is the shortest realistic time from contract award to go-live, and what does it depend on?
Subcontractors the Proponent intends to use, and the portion of the work each will perform, are to be listed.
Assumptions and exclusions that affect the prices quoted are to be stated.
Provide a fixed price for the Services using the Pricing Schedule in Appendix C (Canadian dollars, excluding GST).
questions.constraints: Appendix C; Canadian dollars, excluding GST

questions.question_text: Hourly rates by role for change requests and additional services are required.
Describe any annual price escalation proposed for the term of the contract.
Attach a current Workers' Compensation Board clearance letter.
Provide a copy of your most recent SOC 2 Type II report as an attachment to your Proposal.
Provide three client references for comparable projects using the table in Appendix B.
questions.constraints: three references, table in Appendix B

questions.question_text: The Proponent shall describe the training provided to administrators and end users, including delivery method, duration and materials.
The Proponent shall describe the security controls that protect patron data at rest and in transit.
